Building a UGC creator program at scale requires different roles, systems, and strategies at different stages. In this video, Canyon breaks down how to structure a UGC team, when to focus on creator strategy versus recruitment, what to look for when evaluating creators, and how to create briefs and review processes that improve content quality.

He also explains why narrow niches such as knitting, ballet, and wrestling can work well for creator programs, how to expand into adjacent markets and international markets, and why Instagram has become increasingly important for UGC. The conversation also covers turning organic creator videos into paid ads, using AI for creator recruitment and operations, and the latest updates to Sideshift V3.
